posts.title: Building a Firecracker VM Orchestrator in Go - Part 2: API Server
posts.description: Designing a transport-agnostic API server for Flames, how steering AI on architecture decisions around service layers, idempotency, and persistence tiers shaped the final design.

posts.title: Building a Firecracker VM Orchestrator in Go - Part 1: Provider Interfaces
posts.description: The first post in a series documenting the build-out of Flames, an open-source Firecracker + Jailer VM orchestrator, using Spec-Driven Development with ContextPin and Claude Code.

posts.title: What is Spec-Driven Development?
posts.description: AI can handle scope. The real challenge is how that scope is defined, structured, and kept aligned as the project grows. That is where spec-driven development comes in.
